notes: Replace the old IsLattice hypothesis by IsFullLattice and use its rank and basis-extension API. The original IsLattice requires exactly finite generation and full span; the new IsFullLattice additionally inherits linearIndepOn. Under the theorem's existing IsFractionRing A F assumption, Submodule.IsLattice.of_fg derives that extra condition from finite generation (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Lattice/Basic.lean:187-190); conversely IsFullLattice provides both original fields. Thus this hypothesis is equivalent here, and the basis/Smith-form conclusion is unchanged. Module.Finite and Module.Free for Z are supplied locally by Submodule.IsLattice.finite and free, the former instance APIs now requiring F explicitly; no assumptions are added.
